rules.description: ThinkPad stores the Supervisor Password (SVP) cryptographically linked to the embedded hardware security chip. A DXE driver patch hooks the authentication routine and forces an EVSA clear command.
steps: 1. Read original 16MB BIOS dump from SPI flash.
2. Apply AutoPatcher DXE payload to replace auth hook and flush active NVRAM setup (0x00800000 - 0x0084C000 erased to 0xFF).
3. Flash the patched binary to the motherboard.
4. Power on laptop: custom screen with GIF89a banner appears. Press Space / Enter to execute SVP hardware wipe.
5. Flash back the original BIOS dump. The machine boots 100% password-free.

rules.family: ThinkPad Modern (8th to 11th Gen - Whiskey Lake / Tiger Lake)
rules.description: Applied to 32MB SPI flash chips (such as MX25L25673G / W25Q256JV). Same 2-step DXE hook method tailored for 32MB address space (hook inserted at 0x01452000 - 0x01789000).

rules.technique: Active NVRAM Flush / Donor Rebuild with DMI Transfer
rules.description: IdeaPad series does not have an external SVP crypto chip. Password is held directly in the active NVRAM bank (AMITSESetup / Setup). Clearing the active NVRAM bank or transferring DMI to a clean vendor update binary unlocks the machine immediately.
Preserves Serial Number (e.g. 1S...), Machine Type Model (MTM), UUID, Board Serial and Windows OEM Product Key located in the DMI partition.
